trigger: The historical Qwen2 visual path failed the frozen exact-schema gate before and after its single allowed schema-only retry, so the required two-family visual envelope could not be formed.

claim_boundary.permitted: Gemma 4 and the retained Qwen3-VL path may provide provisional model-model agreement and conservative aggregate uncertainty ranges for synthetic stress calibration after every activation gate passes.
forbidden: ChildLens transcript, referent, or lexical correctness
ChildLens evidence of an acquisition effect

substitution.historical_qwen2_outputs: preserved but excluded from every replacement comparison, interval, intersection, union, and envelope

sample_and_crosswalk.sample: the same prediction-independent frozen primary audit sample only
sample_and_crosswalk.window_rule: Use exactly the already materialized ordered windows whose centers fall in the frozen half-open primary audit intervals [start,end); do not regenerate, filter, expand, or reorder them.

gemma4_provenance_placeholders.activation_guard: A separate immutable activation receipt must replace every placeholder with exact verified values and bind this amendment's SHA-256. Any placeholder, metadata/license contradiction, gated click-through, missing hash, or unpinned transitive runtime keeps the instrument NOT_ACTIVE.

audio.source_interval: the exact frozen half-open candidate interval [window_start,window_end)
audio.decode: Pinned ffmpeg decodes from the inherited read-only media descriptor to mono 16000-Hz signed 16-bit little-endian PCM WAV; sample indices are round(start*16000) through round(end*16000)-1, clamped only to the decoded stream bounds.
audio.resampling_or_channel_fallback: forbidden beyond the declared mono 16000-Hz ffmpeg conversion
audio.temporary_location: owner-private quarantine scratch only, deleted after the window

frames.target_rule: max(0.0, center+offset), formatted to exactly three decimal places
frames.decode: Reuse the pinned Qwen3-VL ffmpeg extractor exactly: seek with -ss before the inherited media descriptor, decode one frame, and apply scale='min(448,iw)':-2.
frames.temporary_location: owner-private quarantine scratch only, each frame deleted after the window

exact_prompt_contract.system_prompt_utf8: You are a fixed local measurement instrument. Use only the supplied audio clip and five ordered frames. Return only the exact JSON object requested. Do not add prose or markdown.
exact_prompt_contract.user_prompt_utf8: The audio is the complete frozen candidate window. The five frames are ordered at offsets -5,-2.5,0,+2.5,+5 seconds from the window center. Classify only what is supported jointly by the spoken audio and visible frames. Count de-duplicated visible noun/object or verb/action candidates related to the speech, not all visible entities. Return exactly one JSON object with exactly these five keys and one allowed string value per key: candidate_count_bin=[zero,one,two,three_or_more,abstain]; visibility_bin=[none,partial,clear,abstain]; referential_status=[visible_candidate,null_or_irrelevant,ambiguous,undecidable]; lexical_support=[noun_object,verb_action,both,neither,undecidable]; lag_event_unit_bin=[lead_two_plus,lead_one,overlap,lag_one,lag_two_plus,undecidable]. Use abstain or undecidable whenever the audio, language, visibility, reference, or temporal relation is insufficient. Do not output confidence, candidate text, transcript text, translation, explanation, prose, or markdown.
exact_prompt_contract.prompt_construction: The pinned processor's exact chat template receives one system message and one user message whose content array follows multimodal_content_order. No dynamic text, transcript, item value, filename, identifier, timestamp, prior prediction, or confidence is interpolated.

generation_and_parser.decode: Decode generated token IDs only, excluding prompt IDs, with the pinned tokenizer, skip_special_tokens=true, and clean_up_tokenization_spaces=false.
generation_and_parser.primary_parser: Trim ASCII whitespace only; reject duplicate JSON keys; parse the entire remaining UTF-8 string as one JSON value; require the exact Draft 2020-12 schema, exact enum spelling, no non-finite value, no extra key, no prose, and no trailing content.

correction_policy.trigger: A public canary or aggregate path gate identifies a transport/parser-only failure before any semantic field, Gemma-Qwen3 agreement, lexical content, visibility pattern, or apparent quality is inspected.
correction_policy.only_permitted_correction: Replace the primary whole-string parser with a deterministic wrapper parser that removes ASCII whitespace and at most one exact outer fenced block of the form ```json newline JSON newline ``` or ``` newline JSON newline ```, then applies the identical duplicate-key and exact-schema validator. It may not search for a JSON substring or ignore any other text.
correction_policy.applies_uniformly: the corrected parser version applies to the public canary and all 137 windows; no per-window fallback
correction_policy.rerun_limit: one complete Gemma path rerun only

public_canary_binding.scope: self-generated public/synthetic audio plus five self-generated frames only
must_bind: complete artifact manifest SHA-256 and bytes
processor, tokenizer, chat-template, generation-config, runtime-lock, and adapter SHA-256 values

comparison_and_aggregation.statistics: Raw agreement, Cohen kappa when mathematically defined, path-specific prevalence and abstention, item-cluster bootstrap intervals, intersection prevalence, union prevalence, disagreement rate, and conservative envelope.

K5_and_rounding.complement_protection: If a published proportion plus any public denominator could reveal a 1-4 item cell or its complement, suppress the complete categorical field.
K5_and_rounding.zero_and_one_policy: Represent only by outward-rounded intervals after K5 eligibility; never publish exact raw counts.
K5_and_rounding.rate_dimensions: round lower bounds down and upper bounds up to the nearest 0.10
K5_and_rounding.absolute_lag_event_units: map categorical lag bins to closed event-unit bands and round outward to the nearest 0.5 event duration
K5_and_rounding.candidate_multiplicity: preserve zero/one/two/three-or-more; simulator maps them to 0/1/2/4
K5_and_rounding.visibility: preserve categorical visibility and round partial-or-clear prevalence outward to 0.10
K5_and_rounding.support: round noun-object and verb-action support prevalence outward to 0.10
K5_and_rounding.clamp: rates to [0,1] and lag magnitude to [0,2.5] event durations

unchanged_gates.usable: Both Qwen3-VL and Gemma paths meet license, provenance, canary, network, schema, coverage, abstention, digest, and confinement gates and every requested visual dimension has model-specific, intersection, union, and conservative-envelope output after K5 suppression and outward rounding.
unchanged_gates.revise: Any activation, transport/parser, schema, coverage, abstention, digest, envelope, K5, or quarantine gate fails after the single permitted correction, or a dimension remains suppressed such that the required envelope cannot be formed.
unchanged_gates.stop: Restricted processing cannot remain local/private, exact provenance or permission cannot be established, or no distinct two-family visual pair can emit the required dimensions.

privacy_and_execution.restricted_inference: local-only under OS network denial after activation

terminal_state.next_task: Resolve Gemma upstream/conversion permission and exact provenance in a separate activation receipt, run the public joint audio-plus-five-frame canary, and only then decide whether restricted replacement inference may activate.
